newsitem.title: USA: PECO sees market focus broadening.
newsitem.headline: PECO sees market focus broadening.

text.p: PECO Energy Co is likely to expand its marketing focus beyond the metropolitan Philadelphia area as a result of an electricity-market deregulation bill passed by the Pennsylvania legislature, a company spokesman said.
"This is going to change the outlook on the part of all utilities, and we do not have to think of our service territories certainly as we did in the past," spokesman Neil McDermott said.
McDermott also said that, as a consequence of the bill, "We (PECO) believe lower electric rates can be achieved in the short run."

Pennsylvania Gov. Tom Ridge said he would sign the bill. The bill seeks to give one-third of the state's consumers an opportunity to choose their electricity supplier by the end of 1998, expanding retail competition to include all consumers by January, 2001.
